caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a wooden roll-top desk. The desk has a rectangular structure with a curved, roll-top cover that is open, revealing a series of segmented vertical and horizontal compartments inside, likely for organizing papers or letters. The desk has four long, slender legs, each with carved detailing at the top and bottom. There are two shallow drawers at the topmost section of the desk, with round knobs, and below them, an open compartment with multiple dividers. Below this, a narrow drawer runs horizontally, also with a knob handle. The writing surface is pulled out, extending forward from the main structure, and beneath it are more storage compartments, including two drawers on each side, also with round knobs. The entire desk is rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, characteristic of polished wood, with darker accents to indicate shadows and depth. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or decorations.
title: Roll-Top Desk
